'''Pinnacle Base''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] base on [[Da Soocha V|Pinnacle Moon]], also known as '''Da Soocha V'''.<ref name="DE">[[Dark Empire 2|''Dark Empire'' 2]]</ref>

==Geography==
It was built within the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] towering jagged, stone spires<ref name="DE" /> created by ancient volcanic eruptions.<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> Hangars, communications centers and barracks were hollowed out in the steep spires, while a large fleet circled around the moon as a vanguard.<ref name="DE" />

==History==
In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] leadership fled there after [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] had been [[Second Battle of Coruscant|retaken]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] warlords and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had returned.<ref name="DE" />

Later, the base was destroyed along with the rest of Pinnacle Moon by the Emperor's [[Galaxy Gun]].<ref name="DEII">[[Dark Empire II 5|''Dark Empire II'' 5]]</ref>
